purpose: Live observation of the ZigZag bottom detector whose CLASSIFICATION numbers are this project's best (71% precision @ 22% recall, 75% @ 10%, 80% @ 5%, PR-AUC 0.60, 2.1-2.4x lift over a 33.5% random base) but whose TRADED form is disproven. The gap between those two facts is the project's central finding.

_params_note: The WALK-FORWARD-SELECTED cell, not the full-sample best. Re-running §3x's selection (trailing 3y, re-picked each January) gives 2023/2024/2025 = (0.6, 0.6%, 0.5%, 24) and 2026 = (0.6, 0.6%, 0.5%, 48). _risk_note: 0.25% of equity per trade. Deliberately small: the strategy is expected to lose, so this is sized to make the losses observable rather than material. With SL at 0.5% of price, one trade risks ~$250 on 100K. Backtest activity was 84-176 active days/year, so expect roughly 60-100 trades/year.

expected_behaviour.win_rate: the detector is 71% precise at flagging bottoms, but the TRADE win rate is far lower — TP is +0.6% and SL is -0.5%, so precision at flagging a pivot does not translate into a favourable payoff
expected_behaviour.expected_pnl: NEGATIVE. Per-year walk-forward Sharpe was -0.91/-1.03/-1.81/-1.87/-0.38/+1.19/+0.34/-3.83 for 2019-2026. Two of eight years were positive.
expected_behaviour.what_to_watch: whether the live fill quality, spread and slippage match the $0.448 round-trip the backtest charged. That is the one thing a live run can teach that the backtest cannot.

_detector: POOLED as of 2026-09-10: trains on gold + clean H1 majors from the same broker feed, predicts gold. Walk-forward AUC 0.7333->0.7434 (+0.0101, 4.6x SE), 11/11 years, p 0.0005. Each aux series is leak-screened at runtime (V5_FINDINGS 3av) and refused above 0.15; falls back to GOLD-ONLY. Detection only - expectancy is unchanged and still NEGATIVE (3x).
_why_this_shape: TOP/BOTTOM DETECTOR WITH ASYMMETRIC PAYOFF, requested 2026-10-16 with the explicit acknowledgement that the detector is not profitable. Built as the best-measured version of 'win much bigger than you lose' rather than the fixed bracket. WHY A 3.0 ATR TRAIL AND NO TAKE-PROFIT: 3bo measured this detector with a trailing stop and found EV/fire of -4.15bp at 1.0 ATR, -2.31bp at 2.0 and +2.22bp at 3.0 -- the ONLY non-negative cell in the family. 3bl had already found that a FIXED bracket costs even the ORACLE -0.94 to -1.43bp against simply holding, because barriers truncate the moves that pay for the losers; a wide trail is the one exit that does not truncate. A take-profit is therefore omitted entirely. 3ax/3ay named 'derive the bracket in ATR, not percent' as the one open actionable item on this harness -- this is it. WHY risk_frac IS 0.0025 AND NOT 0.005: the signal's measured edge is marginal-to-negative (3bl: all six fixed-bracket cells negative GROSS, signed max t -0.098, Reality-Check p 0.820, PBO 0.425), so it gets HALF the champion's risk. HONEST EXPECTANCY, STATED SO IT IS NOT FORGOTTEN: +2.22bp per fire sits inside the pre-registered 4.3% exit-change ceiling (3bo Gate A2), is measured on overlapping events, and payoff asymmetry cannot create expectancy -- EV = p*W - (1-p)*L, and widening W lowers p mechanically since breakeven is p* = L/(W+L). 3r swept 80 SL/TP cells (79/80 Sharpe-negative, DSR 0.0000). This is a measured experiment on a demo account, not a validated edge.
